title: SM-09.15 - What the Email Report feature does
intent: This article answers: SM-09.15 - What the Email Report feature does
short_answer: The Email Report feature allows survey managers to receive automated reports on the number of contributions received by a survey. Reports can be sent daily, weekly or monthly to a designated list of recipients.
important_conditions: Reports are sent only while the survey is published.
Reports stop automatically if the survey is unpublished, archived, frozen or deleted.
Reports can be sent only when at least one contribution was received during the selected period.
